resources.string: Switch between computer and mobile keyboard
Voice input is off in password and private fields.
Offline voice input is not available.
No voice model for this language yet. Tap to download it.
Type here to test the keyboard
Reopen in the last used mode
Capital letter at the start of a sentence
Swipe along the space bar changes the language
The app has no internet permission: no server, no account, no analytics. Typed text and audio are not stored or logged. The dictionary, translation glossary, settings and models stay on this device.
Restore all keyboard settings to their defaults?
The language is written on the space bar; the language key switches it.

Shortcuts work only in the keyboard\'s computer mode (the keyboard button on the top bar), which has Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Win keys. Tap a modifier, then the key: for example Win, then Space switches the language. Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V and other shortcuts of the app itself (Excel, Vim…) work where that app supports them. A combination of modifiers only (for example Alt+Shift) runs when no other key follows within half a second.
Choose Ctrl, Alt or Win with a key, or at least two modifiers without a key.
This replaces a standard command (copy, paste, undo …).
Runs half a second after the last modifier if no key follows.
Single words, only on this phone, never whole messages. Nothing from passwords, private fields or addresses.
From common words and your own (yours first). A long press on a suggestion removes your word.
Only letters, apostrophe and hyphen; 2–40 characters.
Not suggested yet: type it once more
Delete the whole dictionary in all languages?
Models are files that let the keyboard recognise speech and translate right on the phone, without internet. Normal typing works fully without them. Download only what you need — once.
Importing %1$s… this can take a minute.
Needed for the Voice button. Without the model of a language you cannot dictate in it.
Needed for the translation button; each direction is a file of its own. The accurate model translates noticeably better but is three times bigger and slower: for phones with 6 GB of memory or more.
Allow the microphone in the app settings to use voice input.
Say “кома”, “крапка”, “знак питання”, “новий рядок” (Polish: “przecinek”, “kropka”, “znak zapytania”, “nowa linia”; English: “comma”, “period”, “question mark”, “new line”).
The %1$s model is not here yet. Tap to download it.

Above the keys: Aa Text · translate (tap again to pick the other language) · translate the selection or clipboard · Voice. You translate from the keyboard language: switch the keyboard to Polish to translate from Polish. While you type, the field shows your text and the strip above the keys shows the translation; it replaces your text once — automatically after . ! ?, Enter or a pause, in manual mode only after Enter. Tapping ✓ restores the original. Everyday phrases (\"How are you?\") use a built-in phrasebook.
Text changed — restore it by hand
Insert the translation after a pause in typing
More accurate translation (beam search, a little slower)
1. Turn the keyboard on in Android
Android warns that any keyboard can see what you type — this is its standard message. This keyboard has no internet access, so nothing leaves the phone.
All set. Tap any text field to type.
No browser found to open the link.

1. Tap «Download» next to the model you need: the browser saves the file.\n2. When it is done, tap «Open» in the browser and choose OffKey: it installs itself.\nOr tap «Install downloaded files» and pick one or more files.

Any Vosk model for Ukrainian, Polish or English (its name has uk, pl or en). Download the zip on the Vosk page, then «Import» in the language\'s row. For translation the choice above is complete (standard or accurate).

Cheat sheets for popular apps: \"Show tips\" opens a list of the app\'s own shortcuts, for reference only. The \"Add\" button also puts ready-made shortcuts that type text (Excel formulas, Vim commands) into your list; they work in computer mode.
Type on another device over Bluetooth
«%1$s» cannot be typed in the device\'s layout
No device connected · tap for settings
Computer, TV, tablet over Bluetooth · on
Computer, TV, tablet over Bluetooth · off
The phone becomes a Bluetooth keyboard and touchpad for a computer, a TV or a tablet. Nothing to install on them.
Use the phone as a keyboard for other devices
Bluetooth is off on the phone
This phone does not allow keyboard mode (some manufacturers block it).

Tap «Make the phone visible», then on the device open Bluetooth → Add device and choose this phone. Add as many devices as you like, one by one. Next time they connect by themselves, or tap «Connect».

• A tap on the Bluetooth button above the keys: typing goes to the device (the button lights up). Another tap: back to the phone.
• Not connected yet: the tap connects to the first ★ device (the button pulses while it connects).
• A long press: on to the next ★ device, round and round.
• The touchpad button: a mouse, or arrows for a TV box.
Tap here to open the keyboard

The keyboard sends keys, not letters: the device\'s language decides the letter. Set it to the keyboard\'s language (Укр/Pol/Eng); with another one, its letters come out in the same places. While typing goes to a device, suggestions, translation and voice wait; text from the clipboard is typed there.
Another tap on the translation button above the keys moves on to the next language.

If the translation gets a word or phrase wrong, write the right version here. The keyboard puts it into the translation itself; a line that is a whole sentence is used as the translation of that sentence.

One line per word: українська | polski | English. Several forms with «/»: the first is used in translations. «*» at the end matches any ending, e.g. палет* = палета, палети, палетах. Lines starting with # are notes.
Installing… large models take a minute.
Last time the app closed with an error. Please copy the text and send it to the developer.
This app does not accept stickers from keyboards
Stickers cannot be sent to a computer
Emoji or text smileys separated by spaces, e.g. 🦄 🐙 ¯\\_(ツ)_/¯. They get their own ★ page in the emoji panel.
The 🕘 page shows the emoji you use most; it fills up by itself.
Add GIF, WebP, PNG or JPEG pictures from the phone (up to 8 MB). In the sticker panel, a long press adds a sticker to favourites ★; favourites and the most used come first.
Show the pressed letter above the finger
Compact: one row, modes under the ▦ button
Drag Backspace to the left to delete words
Kept «%1$s»; it will not be corrected again
How to use, backup, reset · version %1$s
Frames and light of the keys.

OffKey is a keyboard for Ukrainian, Polish and English: suggestions and corrections, your own dictionary, voice and translation, emoji, a computer layout, and a Bluetooth keyboard and touchpad for a computer.

Import adds words from a file:
• .txt — one word per line; the words go to the language selected above (%1$s);
• JSON — a list per language: {"uk": ["слово"], "pl": ["słowo"], "en": ["word"]}.
Words shorter than 4 letters are skipped. Export saves all your words as JSON, most used first.

One file with all settings (own emoji and shortcuts included), your dictionary and the translation glossary. Restoring replaces what is on this phone now. Voice and translation models are not included: add them again on the models page.
This file is not an OffKey backup.
Arrows, Home and End above the letters of the mobile keyboard.
Hide the buttons until the strip is tapped
Only the text shows; a tap on it brings the buttons for a few seconds.

• Turn OffKey on in the phone\'s list of keyboards and choose it: the main screen shows how.\n• «Try it» on the main screen: try everything from this help there.\n• «Look and sound»: the style, brightness, key height, sounds.

• Hold a letter: its variants (ґ, ї, Polish letters, the digit in its corner).
• Hold the comma: emoji.
• Swipe along the space bar: another language.
• Hold ⌫: deletes; drag it left: whole words.
• Hold the space bar and move: the cursor.
• Tap the strip above the keys: the buttons (modes on the left, keyboard and settings on the right).

• A typo is fixed when the word ends; ⌫ right after brings your word back and remembers it.
• Suggestions above the keys: a tap puts the word in; hold to remove a word of yours.
• After a space: words that usually come next.
• Turn off: «Typing».

• A sentence starts with a capital by itself.
• Two quick spaces: «. ».
• Spaces round commas and marks are put right.
• ⌫ right after such a change puts it back.
• A field for numbers or a phone number: the number pad at once.\n• Hold the full stop: a comma.\n• «?123»: symbols; «ABC»: back to the letters.

• The keyboard button on the strip: a computer keyboard (Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, Win, Fn, arrows) or back to the phone one.\n• Ctrl, Alt, Win: a tap for the next key, two quick taps to keep them.\n• Your own key combinations: «Languages and keyboard».

• 🎤: dictate; say «comma», «full stop», «new line» for marks.
• ⇄: translate; again: another direction. The translation goes in after a finished sentence, a pause after a word, or Enter.
• ↶: the original back.
• The models are downloaded once: «Voice and translation» → «Offline models». The phone itself recognises and translates. • In translation mode everything typed or dictated is translated; typos are not fixed in it (⌫ corrects).
• Your own models: a larger, more accurate translation is offered right there («accurate»); for voice any Vosk model from alphacephei.com/vosk/models (its name must contain uk, pl or en): download the zip in the browser, then «Other models» → «Import».

• «Computer» → turn on; the first time, «Make the phone visible» and add it on the computer (Bluetooth → Add device).\n• The Bluetooth button on the keyboard: keys go to the computer; again: back to the phone.\n• The touchpad: a mouse, or arrows (the button in its corner) for a TV box.
• Hold the comma and let go: emoji; the arrows turn the pages, the first is the most used.\n• Your own emoji and stickers: «Emoji and stickers».
• «My dictionary»: add, find and delete your words; import and export them.\n• A full copy (settings, emoji, combinations, dictionary): «Help and more» → «Backup».
An old typewriter: round keys on levers
The same machine in light colours: milky keys in bronze, brown letters, old map paper
Hold the space bar and slide to move the cursor
Looks at the two words before.
The edges of the keys move to where you actually tap.
Translate the selection or the clipboard
Copy a text — it will be here for an hour (pinned ones stay)

Chronicle: keys click, the space bar thumps, Enter is the carriage return. Atelier: a pencil writes. Poise: bubble wrap pops. Silent while the phone is on silent or vibrate; how loud is set by the phone\'s «System sounds» volume: this slider can only make it quieter.
How should the keyboard be set up?
Everything that helps you type: suggestions, corrections, a dictionary that learns your words and taps. Translation and voice: turn them on when you need them.
Just a keyboard: no suggestions, corrections or mode buttons, nothing remembered.
Go through every setting with the helper
Every group of settings in turn, each point explained as in the help; you choose what to turn on.
Which languages do you write in?
Suggestions, corrections and a learning dictionary
Translation and voice typing are offered the first time you touch their buttons: then you download the model they need.
Key sounds on or off; hold to set the volume
Bell at the end of a line
Hold the speaker and slide your finger along the strip without letting go
Only pinned texts: hold one to unpin, or swipe it left
Deleted · tap here to bring it back
★ marks the devices a long press on the Bluetooth button goes round, in the order you star them. A tap goes back to typing on the phone.
Star ★ the devices to switch between in the device settings (tap)
%1$s did not answer (out of reach or off?)
The app behind the keyboard is blurred.
This phone does not blur behind windows now (it may not be able to, or battery saver and «Allow window-level blurs» in the developer options turn it off): the glass stays solid.
The keyboard\'s window reaches above the keys, so blur is off (it would blur the app there too): the glass stays solid.
Blur behind the keyboard needs Android 12 or newer: the glass stays solid.
A light see-through where the app allows it.
Open the keyboard once in glass: then this shows whether the phone blurs the app behind it.
Something wrong? Send a short report through Share (a messenger or e-mail): the app version and the phone are added; describe what happened.
The keyboard stopped with an error last time. Send the report through Share: it helps to fix it.
Every setting back to the start, then the first setup again.
The keyboard\'s languages and which keyboard opens.
Words offered above the keys while you type, and the next word after a finished one. The dictionary can learn the words you type, on this phone only.
How the keys behave and what gestures do.
Each style has its own sound. Volume and vibration strength are in «Look and sound».
Dictation and translation work on the phone, without the internet, once their models are downloaded.
When you need it: «Other devices» in the settings.
Low keys with the cursor row make the letters small: raise the key height in «Look and sound».
Almost every button is hidden now: a tap on the strip shows them.
Suggestions and corrections paused · tap «Text» to bring them back
Off: the keyboard only types, and the «Text» button is gone.
Removes the space before , . ! ? and puts one after.
Off: there is no voice button on the keyboard.
Off: there is no translation button on the keyboard.
The translation comes 2 s after a word.
Put . ! or ? and the whole sentence is translated.
«Suggestions and corrections» is off («Text and keys»): nothing is learned or suggested.
These look like common words cut short and will be removed from your dictionary: %1$s

The settings open from the OffKey icon. Two steps: turn OffKey on in Android\'s list of keyboards and make it the main one. Android warns that a keyboard sees what you type: it says so about every keyboard. OffKey has no internet access, so nothing you type leaves the phone.
At the top of the settings\' main page. Try everything from this help there without leaving the settings.

The first setup offers three ways. Standard: everything that helps you type (suggestions, corrections, learning); translation and voice stay off until you turn them on. Minimum: just a keyboard, no row of mode buttons, nothing remembered. The helper goes through every group of settings with these explanations. To start again: «Help and more» → «Reset».

Shows the end of your text, suggestions and the keyboard\'s notes. A tap on a word puts the cursor there, a long press selects the word; a long text can be swiped back. Notes are slanted with ⓘ; an underlined one can be tapped.
Opens OffKey\'s settings. Pale while you type in the settings themselves. While dictating it becomes ✕: cancel.

Switches between the mobile keyboard and the computer one (Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, Win, F1–F12, arrows). Grey while a panel is in place of the keys. It can be taken away in «Buttons above the keys»; while typing goes to another device it is always there.
A tap turns the key sounds on or off. Hold it and slide along the strip: the volume. Only in styles with sounds. It can be taken away: «Text and keys» → «Buttons above the keys».

There when «Other devices» is on. A tap: typing goes to the connected device (the button lights up); another tap: back to the phone. Not connected: the tap connects to the first ★ device, and the button pulses while it connects. A long press: on to the next ★ device.

There while typing goes to a device. In place of the keys: slide to move the mouse, tap to click, two fingers to scroll. The button in the corner switches to arrows (for a TV): a swipe is one arrow, a swipe held repeats it, a tap is Enter.
With the compact toolbar the mode buttons are under this button; a tap opens their row. Lit while translating or dictating.

Plain typing. When you are in it already, a tap pauses suggestions and corrections (the button then says just «Text»); another tap brings them back. From translation it goes back to plain typing. The main switch «Suggestions and corrections» takes the button away.

Turns translation on from the keyboard\'s language; the button shows the direction, e.g. «Укр→Pol». Another tap: the next language. Without its model the tap says where to download it. The «Translation» switch in «Voice and translation» takes the button away.

In place of the keys: the texts copied in the last hour. A tap pastes, a long press pins (pinned ones stay), a swipe to the left removes. ⇄ translates the selection or the clipboard, ✕ forgets the unpinned ones (two taps). «АБВ»: back to the keys. While typing goes to a device, the text is typed there.
Dictation; the button becomes «Stop», and ✕ at the right cancels. Needs the language\'s model. The «Voice input» switch takes the button away.
Shown after a translation: puts your own text back in its place.

On: one row above the keys, the mode buttons under ▦. Off: a second row with Text, Translation, Clipboard and Voice. Each mode button has its own place; one taken away in the settings leaves its place empty, so the others never move. None wanted: no row at all.
On: the mobile keyboard shows only the text strip; a tap on it shows the buttons for a few seconds.
Three collections: Poise (glass), Atelier (pencil on paper), Chronicle (a typewriter). A tap on a collection shows its two variants, dark and light; the keyboard changes when you choose a variant.
«Look and sound» shows the real keyboard with your settings at its top: it changes as you move a slider. Tapping it plays the sound and vibration; it types nothing.
On: the app shows lightly through the glass where the phone can do it. Off: the glass is solid.
Frames, sheen and light of the keys; on milky glass also the tone of the glass. The letters dim only a little.
The height of the key rows, 70–140 %.

Each style has its sound: Chronicle clacks (the space bar thuds, Enter is the carriage return), Atelier writes with a pencil, Poise pops bubble wrap. Volume: the slider, or hold the sound button. Silent when the phone is on silent or vibrate; the loudest is set by the phone\'s «System sounds».
A light, medium or strong answer to every key; off: no vibration.

«Text and keys» → «Suggestions and corrections». On: everything below works and the keyboard has the «Aa Text» button. Off: the keyboard only types (no suggestions, corrections or learning) and the button is gone. For a pause without the settings: a tap on «Text» on the keyboard.
When a word ends (a space or a mark), a typo in it is fixed and the strip says what became what. ⌫ right after: your word comes back and is never fixed again. Off: words stay as typed.

Three words above the keys that begin with what you typed; a tap puts the word in with a space. A long press on a suggestion removes your own word. After a space, smaller at the right: words that usually come next. Turned on in «My dictionary».
On: the next word is chosen by the two words before it; off: by the last one only.
Removes the space before , . ! ? and puts one after; after ! and ? the next word starts with a capital. ⌫ right after: as it was. Mobile keyboard only.

Words that are not in the dictionary are remembered and suggested first. Single words only, only on this phone; nothing from passwords, private fields, addresses or search boxes, and no common words cut short. Off: nothing new is learned, but saved words are still suggested (remove them in «My dictionary»).
Capital at the start of a sentence
After . ! ? and at the start of a field Shift turns on by itself. Mobile keyboard.
Two quick spaces after a word make «. ».
In a field for numbers or a phone number: digits at once. «?123»: symbols, «АБВ»: back. Hold the full stop: a comma. Hold a letter: its variants (ґ, ї, Polish letters, the digit in its corner).
The pressed letter is shown large above the finger. Chronicle has it off at first: its key goes down by itself.
Hold ⌫ and drag to the left: whole words go, and the strip shows what will be deleted. Held without moving: letter by letter.
Hold the space bar and slide: the cursor moves through the text.
Language by a swipe on the space bar
A quick swipe along the space bar: the next language. With the cursor on the space bar too, the swipe must be longer and quicker, so it is never taken for the cursor.
The keyboard notes where you actually tap on each letter and moves the edges of the keys a little. «Forget how I tap»: start again.
Arrows, Home and End above the letters of the mobile keyboard. The keyboard does not grow: the keys get a little lower.
Hold the comma and let go: the emoji.
Add a word by hand, search, delete; the language is chosen above the list.
If pieces of common words were remembered before («швидк» for «швидко»), this button lists them and removes them when you agree.
Words from a .txt file (one per line) or JSON; the export puts all your words into one file.
Ukrainian, Polish, English: turn on the ones you need. The current language is written on the space bar; the language key or a swipe on the space bar switches it.
Which keyboard opens. «Open in the last mode»: as you left it. Both work for typing on the phone and on another device.
Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, Win, Fn, F1–F12, arrows. Ctrl, Alt, Win: a tap holds them for the next key, two quick taps lock them. Win, then the space bar: the language.
There when the computer keyboard is chosen: your own shortcuts that do something or type a text.

On: the keyboard has the «Voice» button. Dictate; «comma», «period», «question mark», «new line» put the marks (in Ukrainian «кома», «крапка», …). The phone itself recognises the speech, without the internet.

On: the keyboard has the translation button. It translates from the keyboard\'s language: to translate from Polish, switch the keyboard to Polish. While you write, the field has your text and the translation is above the keys; it replaces your text once. Everyday phrases come from a built-in phrasebook.
After each word: 2 s after a word. After a sentence: when you put . ! or ?. Only at Enter: each translation after Enter. Enter translates in all three.
«First translate into»: the language to start with. On the keyboard another tap on the translation button moves on to the next language that has a model.

Files for voice and translation, downloaded once: «Voice and translation» → «Offline models». The accurate translation model is better but three times bigger and slower; the keyboard always gets the best out of the model, so a weaker phone takes the standard one. For voice any Vosk model (uk, pl, en) fits: «Other voice models».
Your right words and phrases: the keyboard puts them into the translation.
⇄ in the clipboard translates the selected text, or the last copied one when nothing is selected, and puts the translation in.
Hold the comma and let go. The arrows turn the pages; 🕘 the most used, ★ your own. The stickers\' character is chosen on the panel itself.
Your own emoji or text smileys, separated by spaces: a page ★ of their own.
GIF, WebP, PNG or JPEG pictures from the phone. A long press on a sticker makes it a favourite. Stickers go only to apps that accept them.
The phone becomes a Bluetooth keyboard and touchpad for a computer, a TV or a tablet; nothing to install on them. Android 9 or newer.
«Other devices» → turn on → «Make the phone visible», then on the device: Bluetooth → Add device. There can be several devices.
Star ★ devices in the list; a long press on the Bluetooth button goes round them in the order you starred them.
The keyboard sends keys, not letters: the device\'s language decides the letter. Set it to the keyboard\'s language (the strip says which); with another one, its letters come out in the same places.
While typing goes to a device, suggestions, translation and voice wait; text from the clipboard is typed there.
One file: settings, dictionary, translation glossary, your emoji and shortcuts. Restoring replaces what is on the phone now. Models are not in it.
All settings as at first, and the dictionary too if you wish; then the first setup again.
No internet permission: no text leaves the phone. What you type and say is not stored.
Help while typing. One main switch turns it all on or off.
The buttons above the keys: only those you need.
While typing goes to another device, it is always there.
A button that switches between two things shows where a tap leads. An on/off button shows its state.
